_comment: Tool selectors. A selector keeps the tools of its type, in library order, for which every `keep` condition holds, checked in order; the first that fails turns the tool down, and `else_reject` says why. Conditions in a list are checked in order, as `&&` would be. Then it prefers the first kept, or the largest by a value, ties going to the first or the last in library order. Expressions are arithmetic and comparisons over the selector's inputs, its `let` values, the library's values (drill_tolerance_mm), step2cam's constants (tip_clearance_mm) and the tool's fields (`tool.diameter`). A tool field that is missing or not a number fails every comparison, so that tool is not chosen.

selectors.description: The drill closest to the diameter and never larger, at most drill_tolerance_mm under it.

keep.else_reject: {tool.id}: ⌀{tool.diameter:raw} is more than {drill_tolerance_mm} mm under the ⌀{diameter} hole

selectors.description: The largest end mill that fits inside the diameter with room to helix.

keep.else_reject: {tool.id}: ⌀{tool.diameter:raw} leaves no room to helix in ⌀{diameter}

selectors.description: The largest end mill narrower than the width whose flutes reach the depth.

keep.else_reject: {tool.id}: ⌀{tool.diameter:raw} is too wide for the {width} mm width
{tool.id}: its {tool.flute_length:raw} mm flutes do not reach {depth} mm down

selectors.description: The widest sharp V-bit no wider than the channel's angle: a wider one would cut its walls, a flat tip could not reach the root.

keep.else_reject: {tool.id}: its ⌀{tool.tip_diameter:raw} flat tip cannot reach the root
{tool.id}: its {tool.angle:raw}° is wider than the {angle}° channel

selectors.description: The first 90° chamfer mill wide enough for the width with its tip clear of the edge.

keep.else_reject: {tool.id}: too small for a {width} mm chamfer with its tip clear of the edge

selectors.description: The largest thread mill whose pitch range takes the pitch, that fits the drilled hole, whose neck clears the crests and that reaches the thread's bottom.

keep.else_reject: {tool.id}: its ⌀{tool.neck_diameter:raw} neck would rub the thread crests
{tool.id}: reaches {reach} mm, the thread ends {below:r} mm below the stock top
